crossRefs.note: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that…
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: Daniel spoke and said, “I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea.
translations.bsb: Daniel declared: “In my vision in the night I looked, and suddenly the four winds of heaven were churning up the great sea.
translations.kjv: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.
translations.asv: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of heaven brake forth upon the great sea.
